notes_for_editor: The brief has no events for Birch Lake, and the listing gives a position and a towerman but no height, build year or agency, so the facts block is empty. The memoir is a personal account by a family member. Its photo caption places the father's tower near Meadow Lake, so it does not confirm a Birch Lake tower; the story says so. The brief's agency field is not supported by any page read. Two sources were read, and one search found nothing else. The story is about 145 words. Editor should decide whether the memoir belongs in the story at all.
